tools.name: get_norwegian_company
tools.description: Full profile of one Norwegian company by organisation number: register details, contact information, activity, CEO, board, auditor and accountant, and the latest filed revenue and profit.

tools.name: get_norwegian_company_financials
tools.description: Up to three years of filed annual accounts for a Norwegian company: revenue, operating and net profit, payroll, assets, equity, debt and cash, with growth, margin and equity ratio. Set consolidated for group accounts.

tools.name: get_norwegian_company_group
tools.description: The corporate group (konsern) a Norwegian company belongs to: the top parent and every subsidiary with ownership share. Accepts any member of the group.

tools.name: find_norwegian_industry_codes
tools.description: Look up SN2025 industry codes (the Norwegian NACE standard the register uses) by Norwegian or English words or a code prefix. Use the codes in search_norwegian_companies; a broader code such as 62 includes all its subclasses.

tools.name: find_norwegian_company_websites
tools.description: Find the websites of one to five Norwegian companies and the platform each runs on, such as Shopify or WooCommerce. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_feedback" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_norwegian_companies, find_norwegian_company_websites · Private data: get_norwegian_company, submit_feedback · Public sink: search_norwegian_companies, get_norwegian_company_group, find_norwegian_company_websites, submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_norwegian_companies, find_norwegian_company_websites · Private data: get_norwegian_company, submit_feedback · Public sink: search_norwegian_companies, get_norwegian_company_group, find_norwegian_company_websites, submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
